_doc: Heroes' own lives between jobs (Systems/Downtime.cs). Once a week (by id) each hero in town with gold to spare does something with it, in this order: buys land and a house of their own (landCost plus landPerLevel a level, paid to the town; then they sleep there instead of the tavern, gain rootLoyalty once and rooted a day after), trains (trainPerLevel a level, for trainXp of their next level, at most trainMaxLevel), or buys a stake in a business in town (stake gold into its till, paying back dividend of it a day while the till has it). They can still be called up for any job.
holdings: a narrow house on the hill
an old tower by the river
a cottage with a walled garden
a hunting lodge at the forest's edge

lines.land: {hero} buys {holding} for {cost} gold, and sleeps under their own roof between jobs.
lines.train: {hero} pays {cost} gold for a week's hard training with {trainer}.
lines.stake: {hero} buys a stake in {business} for {cost} gold.

trainers: a priest who once marched with the crusades
